prompt: Build a four-week awareness plan for a B2B observability product aimed at platform engineers.
expected: A concise awareness-stage plan with audience problem, one measurable next action, channel-fit assets, distribution, and a review metric.
actual: Dry-run result: identify platform-engineer pain around incident visibility, use awareness-stage educational articles and short technical posts, bridge to an incident-readiness checklist, assign qualified checklist starts as the next action, and review qualified reach plus checklist starts after four weeks.

prompt: Turn our recorded customer webinar into a LinkedIn campaign and email sequence, but we do not know whether we have permission to use attendee questions.
expected: A channel-specific repurposing plan that preserves consent boundaries, separates approved source material, and defines a measurement and review path.
actual: Dry-run result: use only the approved recording and presenter material, exclude attendee questions until permission is confirmed, create an evidence-led LinkedIn carousel and a three-email sequence, adapt wording for each channel, and review qualified demo requests after the agreed attribution window.

prompt: Run paid search ads for my product tomorrow.
expected: The skill should not over-trigger: it should identify paid-media execution as out of scope and offer a content brief or landing-page input if useful.
actual: Dry-run result: identify paid-media execution as out of scope, then offer to prepare audience messaging, content assets, or a landing-page brief that supports the campaign.
